scientific_integrity: Formal steps are written in RESULT.md and finite checks are independently recomputed by included standard-library verifier; originality and value received self-review only, not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Independent fair binary colours, blocks exactly equal in size, both block number and size diverge, pure first-order vocabulary {E,P} only. Arbitrary noncomputable block-count sequences need not yield effectively decidable critical regimes. Finite checks are not proofs of asymptotics. Historical priority of a stronger generic independent-colour class theorem is unresolved.
title: A sharp first-order convergence criterion for fair colourings of equal-block equivalence structures
